item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/csv-insights.XXXXXX)
printf '"'group,value,word\\nZ,1E5,z\\nA,0.01,a\\nZ,0.01,z\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/decimal.csv"
printf '"'a,a\\n1,2\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/duplicate.csv"
printf '"'a,b\\n\"unterminated,1\\n' > \""'$tmpdir/malformed.csv"
python3 -m py_compile main.py
actual=$(python3 main.py "$tmpdir/decimal.csv" --group-by group --sum value --avg value)
expected='"'[{\"group\":\"A\",\"sum_value\":0.01,\"avg_value\":0.01},{\"group\":\"Z\",\"sum_value\":100000.01,\"avg_value\":50000.005}]'
test \""'$actual" = "$expected"
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/decimal.csv" --where word=z --output csv > "$tmpdir/out.csv"
printf '"'group,value,word\\nZ,1E5,z\\nZ,0.01,z\\n' | cmp -s - \""'$tmpdir/out.csv"
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/duplicate.csv" >/dev/null 2>"$tmpdir/error1"; first=$?
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/malformed.csv" >/dev/null 2>"$tmpdir/error2"; second=$?
python3 main.py "$tmpdir/decimal.csv" --sum value >/dev/null 2>"$tmpdir/error3"; third=$?
test "$first" -ne 0 && test "$second" -ne 0 && test "$third" -ne 0
rg -q '"'headers must be unique' \""'$tmpdir/error1"
rg -q '"'malformed CSV' \""'$tmpdir/error2"
rg -q '"'require --group-by' \""'$tmpdir/error3"
printf '"'self-tests passed\\n'
rm -rf \""'$tmpdir"'
